title: Journey Stamps

blocks.p: Journey Stamps are collected as you experience certain aspects of the game and grant you rewards for doing so. Once a stamp is received, it is kept for the remainder of the game.
Found at the bottom-right of your trainer area, the stamp sheet can be filled using the Decal tool in Tabletop Simulator.

blocks.digital: In this game, the game stamps the sheet for you when a condition is met.

blocks.p: Stamps can be claimed in any order and are immediately awarded upon their condition being met. The conditions for each stamp are as follows:

list: You fail to capture a wild Pokémon 2 turns in a row during a battle.
You win a battle against another trainer or an Ultra Beast.
You have at least 1 of every Apricorn type in your bag.
You have captured a Legendary Pokémon.
You have 3 or more held items equipped in your party.
You have been victorious at a Swarm Battle.
You have 3 different Change of Fate cards in your hand.

blocks.p: Use the button at the bottom-right of the stamp sheet to flip over to the rewards side to see what you get when you reach each milestone.
Stamp rewards may be claimed immediately after reaching each milestone:

ol: Gain 1 Red, 1 Blue and 1 Yellow Apricorn.
Randomly draw 5 Weak Pokémon cards, store them next to your trainer area. You may teach these cards as moves to your Pokémon.
Gain 1 Pink, 1 Green and 1 White Apricorn.
Randomly draw 5 Moderate Pokémon cards, store them next to your trainer area. You may teach these cards as moves to your Pokémon.
Randomly draw 5 Strong Pokémon cards, store them next to your trainer area. You may teach these cards as moves to your Pokémon.
Gain a Scroll of Nobility that allows you to use the Noble Form (State 2) of any fully evolved Starter Pokémon when held.

blocks.digital: In this game, the game flips the sheet and gives you the rewards.
